en_before: Use the size chart for the exact garment. Identify the fiber responsible for stretch separately from the knit construction when reading the size chart and checking recovery. A stretchy fabric alone is no reason to size down. A fitted piece is designed differently from a loose one, and you may need to read their finished measurements differently. Our online sizing guide explains how to distinguish body and garment measurements before comparing sizes.
